violate the law: Riding a scooter without a helmet will violate the law, and the police may give you a heavy fine.
騎機車不戴安全帽會違法，警察可能會開你一張高額罰單。
violate one's rights: Searching students' bags without a good reason may violate their rights, according to the new school policy.
根據學校新政策，沒有正當理由就搜查學生的書包可能會侵犯他們的權利。
violate a rule: Players who violate a rule during the game will have to sit on the bench for five minutes.
比賽中違規的球員必須在板凳上坐五分鐘。
violate one's privacy: Posting photos of your friends online without asking may violate their privacy and hurt your friendship.
沒問過朋友就把他們的照片貼上網可能會侵犯他們的隱私，並傷害你們的友誼。
violate a treaty: If either country decides to violate a treaty signed for peace, the fighting may start again.
如果任一國家決定違反為和平而簽的條約，戰鬥可能會再度爆發。
violate the trust: When the manager secretly sold customers' data, he violated the trust they had placed in the company.
當經理偷偷販賣顧客資料時，他辜負了顧客對公司的信任。
voice concerns: Many parents voiced concerns about the new bus schedule because their children would have to leave home at six.
許多家長對新的校車時刻表表達疑慮，因為他們的孩子得在六點出門。
voice an opinion: Everyone is welcome to voice an opinion during the class meeting, even if it is different from the others'.
班會時歡迎每個人發表意見，即使跟別人的不同也沒關係。
voice support: Thousands of fans went online to voice support for the young player after he was injured in the final.
在那位年輕球員於決賽中受傷後，數千名球迷上網表示支持。
voice objections: Several neighbors voiced objections to the plan to build a factory next to the elementary school.
好幾位鄰居對在國小旁邊蓋工廠的計畫提出反對。
voice one's doubts: Before signing the contract, my father voiced his doubts to the salesman about the hidden costs.
在簽約之前，我爸爸向業務員說出他對隱藏費用的疑慮。
voice a complaint: If the food in the restaurant is cold, you have every right to voice a complaint to the manager.
如果餐廳的食物是冷的，你完全有權利向經理表達不滿。
voice one's feelings: It is healthy to voice your feelings to someone you trust instead of keeping everything inside.
向你信任的人表達感受是健康的，而不是把一切悶在心裡。
volunteer information: Nobody asked him, but the shop owner volunteered information about the car that hit the old man.
沒有人問他，但店老闆主動提供了撞到那位老先生的車子的資訊。
volunteer for a task: When the teacher needed someone to clean the fish tank, Kevin was the first to volunteer for a task nobody wanted.
當老師需要有人清魚缸時，凱文是第一個自願承擔這項沒人想做的任務的人。
volunteer at a shelter: Every Saturday my sister and I volunteer at a shelter, where we feed and walk the homeless dogs.
每週六我和姊姊都在收容所當志工，在那裡餵流浪狗和遛狗。
volunteer one's services: After the earthquake, many doctors volunteered their services and treated the injured for free.
地震過後，許多醫生自願服務，免費治療傷患。
volunteer an answer: The question was difficult, so it was a long time before anyone in the class would volunteer an answer.
這個問題很難，所以過了好久班上才有人願意主動回答。
vote for a candidate: Before you vote for a candidate, you should find out what he or she plans to do for the city.
在你投票給候選人之前，你應該了解他或她打算為這座城市做什麼。
vote on the proposal: The student council will vote on the proposal to allow phones at lunch time next Monday.
學生會將在下週一就允許午餐時間使用手機的提案進行表決。
vote down a bill: Many lawmakers plan to vote down a bill that would raise taxes on small family businesses.
許多立委打算否決一項會對小型家庭企業加稅的法案。
vote with one's feet: When the cafeteria food got worse, students voted with their feet and started eating at the shops outside.
當學生餐廳的伙食變差時，學生們用腳投票，開始去校外的店吃飯。
vote someone out: If the mayor keeps breaking his promises, the people will vote him out at the next election.
如果市長一直不守承諾，人民會在下次選舉中投票把他罷免下台。
vote of confidence: The coach's decision to let me start the final game was a real vote of confidence in my ability.
教練讓我先發出賽決賽的決定，是對我能力的一次真正的信任投票。
vow revenge: In the movie, the hero vows revenge on the man who burned down his family's farm.
在電影裡，主角誓言報復那個燒掉他家農場的人。
vow to fight: The villagers vowed to fight the plan to build a garbage dump next to their river.
村民們誓言奮戰，反對在他們的河邊蓋垃圾場的計畫。
vow never to return: After escaping the war, the family vowed never to return to the village where they had lost everything.
逃離戰爭後，這家人發誓不再回到那個讓他們失去一切的村莊。
take a vow: The new police officers take a vow to protect the people and to always tell the truth.
新任警察立誓要保護人民並且永遠說實話。
break a vow: My grandmother always told us that it is shameful to break a vow you made in front of your family.
我奶奶總是告訴我們，違背你在家人面前許下的誓言是可恥的。
marriage vows: At the wedding, the bride and groom read their marriage vows in front of all their friends and family.
在婚禮上，新娘和新郎在所有親友面前念出他們的結婚誓言。
